notes.title: Patch Notes for Demon Hunters 2.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256073/74e68f7ffb91b9a3a5da3eb3ce1ce878254c2fc3.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added a [TAB]/[SELECT] label next to quests to remind players that the window exists—no more missing it!
[*] A coin sound now plays when making purchases—let the spender hear it.
[*] Enemies no longer attack immediately when the player enters a room—some said the game was too hard.
[*] Weapon switch buttons on the screen have been disabled; now, you can only switch weapons using the keyboard or gamepad—hope you know the hotkeys!
[*] Increased the drop rate of quivers from skeleton archers—more quests incoming!
[*] Adjusted the Knight's stats—yes, mistakes happen.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256073/942436033607c34a42d03a70635ddab13e584b07.png[/img]

notes.title: Demon Hunters 2.0.2 | Small Changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with overlapping battle music
[*] Improved animations
[*] Adjusted character stats
[*] Rebalanced difficulty in the first dungeon level – the first encounter is now less dangerous
[*] More objects in rooms can now be broken – time for some destruction!
[*] Some enemies can now break environmental objects
[*] Added new data to the statistics screen
[/list]

Enjoy the game, Hunters!

Added new data to the statistics screen

notes.title: Demon Hunters v1.7.5
notes.content:
Major changes:
[list]
[*] redesigned visual style of all dungeons: new rooms for 4 types of dungeons, starting rooms, boss rooms and several types of regular rooms, new lighting, new atmosphere
[*] interactive lamps (light can be turned on and off with "E")
[*] added a dash, now the player can move faster and pass through enemies with "Space"
[*] added sounds for traps: saw and spikes
[*] added a card game "Guess the card" to the swindler
[*] changes in the balance of mobs: damage and attack speed
[*] changed the musical theme in the main menu
[*] fixed a bug with smoke after shots
[*] localized the names of the tabs in tab-menu
[/list]

Changes that may appear in the demo version will be included in the next update. The rest can be found in the main release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256073/3463fb935783d44ae632f2d52c21c57c3535507b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256073/61566b07086acc48c92a68978e99da7088c20302.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demon Hunters Demo
notes.content:
The long-awaited demo of our game "Demon Hunters" is here! Dive into a world of dungeons, magic, and danger—for free.

💥 What’s included in the demo?
🛡 One hero with unique abilities
🏰 The first four dungeons with procedural generation
⚓ A fearsome pirate boss to test your skills

Why try the demo?

[list]
[*] Experience the game’s atmosphere and give us your feedback.
[*] Explore dungeons and master the combat system.
[*] Be among the first to face the charismatic pirate boss!
[/list]

Download the demo now!

💬 Your feedback will help us make the full release in Spring 2025 even better! Thank you for your support, and enjoy the adventure! 😊

tags.feature: One hero with unique abilities
The first four dungeons with procedural generation
A fearsome pirate boss to test your skills
